review_tests.Detection logic: Rows without parseable date dropped; settlement-side duplicates excluded; GL total by account = TB
review_tests.Output / finding: Stop: data does not reconcile to TB
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide a complete GL export reconciling to the TB.

review_tests.Detection logic: Lines with no VAT code / blank rate
review_tests.Query to client: The following transactions have no VAT code. Please confirm their VAT treatment.

review_tests.Detection logic: Arithmetic: VAT ≠ net × rate AND ≠ gross × rate/(1+rate) (±£0.02)
review_tests.Query to client: VAT on [items] does not match the coded rate. Please provide the invoices.

review_tests.Detection logic: Same supplier/customer used with ≥ 2 different VAT codes in the year
review_tests.Query to client: [Supplier] is coded at different VAT rates. Please confirm whether its supplies are mixed-rate.

review_tests.Detection logic: Manual journals posting to VAT control or with VAT codes
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide support for manual journals affecting VAT.

review_tests.Detection logic: Records/digital links: return figures not traceable to ledger (manual override/spreadsheet)
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm how the VAT return figures are transferred from the ledger to the MTD software.

review_tests.Detection logic: Not registered: rolling 12-month taxable turnover (standard+reduced+zero) > £90k at any month end, or next-30-days > £90k
review_tests.Output / finding: Late registration exposure (output tax from due date)
review_tests.Query to client: Taxable turnover exceeded £90,000 in [month]. Please confirm VAT registration status and effective date.

review_tests.Detection logic: Registered but rolling 12m taxable turnover < £88k and falling
review_tests.Query to client: Turnover is below the deregistration threshold. Do you wish to review voluntary deregistration?

review_tests.Detection logic: Overseas-established client making UK taxable supplies
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm where the business is established and the date of the first UK supply.

review_tests.Detection logic: Deregistered in year AND stock/assets on hand at deregistration with input tax claimed
review_tests.Expected: Output tax on deregistration if VAT > £1,000
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the value of stock and assets held at deregistration.

review_tests.Detection logic: Flat rate: VAT-incl turnover > £230k (exit), wrong sector %, or limited cost test (goods < 2% of turnover or < £1,000/yr) failed but standard % used
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the flat-rate percentage used and the value of relevant goods purchased each quarter.

review_tests.Detection logic: Flat rate AND input tax claimed on non-capital items, or capital goods ≤ £2,000 incl VAT
review_tests.Query to client: Input VAT was claimed while on the Flat Rate Scheme. Please confirm these purchases.

review_tests.Detection logic: Cash accounting: expected taxable supplies > £1.35m (join) or > £1.6m (must leave); DRC/HP/advance-invoice supplies included in the scheme
review_tests.Expected: Eligible; excluded supplies on invoice basis
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the VAT accounting scheme and how reverse-charge and HP supplies are handled.

review_tests.Detection logic: Annual accounting: turnover > £1.6m or interim payments missed
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the annual accounting payment schedule.

review_tests.Detection logic: Sum of output VAT per sales ledger ≠ Box 1 (excluding reverse-charge/PVA entries)
review_tests.Query to client: Output VAT per the sales records differs from Box 1 for [period]. Please provide the VAT return workings.

review_tests.Detection logic: Standard-rated customers/products with zero/exempt lines (outliers)
review_tests.Query to client: Sales to [customer] were coded zero/exempt although usually standard-rated. Please confirm.

review_tests.Detection logic: Invoices dated after quarter end for supplies made before; deposits/advances received with no output VAT
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the supply dates for these invoices and any deposits received.

review_tests.Detection logic: Income nominals other than sales (other income, sundry, rent, commission, scrap, recharges) with no VAT
review_tests.Query to client: Please explain the nature of [income] so its VAT treatment can be confirmed.

review_tests.Detection logic: Grants, donations, sponsorship, insurance claims, compensation received
review_tests.Expected: Outside scope only if no supply in return
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm whether anything was provided in return for [receipt].

review_tests.Detection logic: Gifts/promotional goods to the same person > £50 in a year with input tax claimed
review_tests.Expected: Output tax on business gifts over £50
review_tests.Query to client: Please list business gifts by recipient.

review_tests.Detection logic: Business assets/goods used privately or taken by directors/staff (DLA postings of goods)
review_tests.Expected: Output tax on private use / removal
review_tests.Query to client: Goods charged to the director's loan account were identified. Please confirm whether input VAT was claimed.

review_tests.Detection logic: Supplies to connected parties/staff at below cost or nil charge
review_tests.Expected: OMV risk where customer cannot fully recover
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm pricing of supplies to [connected party] and whether it is VAT-registered.

review_tests.Detection logic: Sales coded 5%
review_tests.Expected: Within a Sch 7A group with evidence
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide evidence supporting the reduced rate on [sales].

review_tests.Detection logic: Sales coded zero-rated (domestic)
review_tests.Expected: Within a Sch 8 group with evidence/certificates
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the basis for zero-rating [sales] and provide supporting certificates.

review_tests.Detection logic: Sales coded exempt
review_tests.Expected: Within a Sch 9 group; partial exemption triggered
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the nature of exempt income.

review_tests.Detection logic: Recharges to clients without VAT (expenses, travel, staff)
review_tests.Expected: Only true disbursements outside scope; staff supplies on full charge
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm whether these recharges meet the disbursement conditions.

review_tests.Detection logic: Gift card/voucher sales
review_tests.Expected: SPV: VAT at issue; MPV: VAT at redemption
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the types of vouchers sold and where they can be used.

review_tests.Detection logic: Disposal of fixed assets (vehicles, equipment, property) with no output VAT
review_tests.Expected: VAT on sale of assets where input tax was recovered
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm sale proceeds and whether VAT was charged on asset disposals.

review_tests.Detection logic: Credit notes without a linked original invoice or issued > 4 years later
review_tests.Expected: Valid credit notes reduce output tax
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the original invoices for these credit notes.

review_tests.Detection logic: Sum of input VAT per purchase ledger + RC + PVA ≠ Box 4
review_tests.Query to client: Input VAT per the purchase records differs from Box 4 for [period]. Please provide workings.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT claimed with no supplier VAT number / receipt-only / pro-forma
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide VAT invoices for these claims.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT on personal/non-business items (personal keyword list)
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the business purpose of [items].

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT on entertaining (client/customer); staff entertainment allowed
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm whether [entertainment costs] related to staff or clients.

review_tests.Detection logic: Fuel input VAT claimed with private use and no fuel scale charge / mileage records
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm private use of vehicles and how fuel VAT is handled.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT on car purchases; full recovery on car lease charges
review_tests.Expected: Car purchase blocked (unless exclusive business use); 50% on leases
review_tests.Query to client: Input VAT was claimed on [car purchase/lease]. Please confirm the vehicle type and private availability.

review_tests.Detection logic: Purchase invoices unpaid > 6 months after later of supply date/due date, input VAT not repaid
review_tests.Query to client: These purchase invoices are over 6 months unpaid. Please confirm status.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT on accruals (no invoice) or apportioned on prepayments
review_tests.Expected: VAT follows the invoice, not the accounting entry
review_tests.Query to client: Input VAT appears to be claimed on accruals without an invoice. Please confirm.

review_tests.Detection logic: Pre-registration claims: goods > 4 years before registration (or no longer held), services > 6 months
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide details of pre-registration purchases claimed.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input VAT on purchases for exempt or outside-scope activities (e.g. share sales, property disposals)
review_tests.Query to client: Please describe the activity these costs relate to.

review_tests.Detection logic: Same supplier, amount and date ±14 days / same invoice ref
review_tests.Query to client: Possible duplicate invoices from [supplier]. Please confirm.

review_tests.Detection logic: Foreign VAT (EU/other) posted to Box 4
review_tests.Expected: Not UK input tax — reclaim via overseas refund
review_tests.Query to client: Foreign VAT appears in input tax. Please confirm.

review_tests.Detection logic: Input tax older than 4 years claimed
Supplier established outside UK (legal form Inc/LLC/GmbH/BV/SARL/Pty/Ltd (IE) …) coded No VAT/zero, with no reverse-charge entry
review_tests.Output / finding: Missing RC (neutral if fully taxable; cost if partly exempt)
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm where [supplier] belongs. Reverse-charge VAT does not appear to have been accounted for.

review_tests.Detection logic: Overseas-established supplier charging UK VAT on B2B services (not a Sch 4A exception)
review_tests.Expected: Reverse charge applies; UK VAT charged is not input tax
review_tests.Query to client: [Supplier] appears overseas but charged UK VAT. Please provide the invoice and confirm the supplying entity.

review_tests.Detection logic: Sales to overseas customers outside scope with no evidence of business status; or land/event/catering services treated as outside scope
review_tests.Expected: B2B general rule with evidence; Sch 4A exceptions taxed where performed
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide evidence that [customer] is in business, and describe the services.

review_tests.Detection logic: Imports: PVA statement totals ≠ Boxes 1/4/7 entries; import VAT claimed from freight agent invoice without C79
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide monthly postponed VAT statements (or C79s).

review_tests.Detection logic: Zero-rated exports of goods without export evidence within 3 months
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide export evidence for [shipments].

review_tests.Detection logic: Gas/electricity bought from overseas supplier
Goods moved to/from Northern Ireland or EU B2C distance sales
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm any movements of goods involving Northern Ireland or EU consumers.

review_tests.Detection logic: Periods filed cover the year with no gap/overlap
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide all VAT returns covering [dates].

review_tests.Detection logic: Box 6 (sum for periods in year, time-apportioned) vs accounts turnover + other taxable income ± cut-off
review_tests.Query to client: Net sales on VAT returns differ from accounts turnover by £[x]. Please explain.

review_tests.Detection logic: VAT control at YE ≠ last return Box 5 + post-period activity − payments
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the VAT control account reconciliation.

review_tests.Detection logic: Internal checks: Box 3 = 1 + 2; Box 5 = |3 − 4|; Box 1/Box 6 implied rate outside expected range for the liability mix
Box 7 vs purchases + expenses + capital in GL (ex wages, depreciation, rates, insurance etc. outside scope)
Exempt income present (rent, finance, insurance commission, education, health) AND full input VAT recovered
review_tests.Query to client: Exempt income was identified. Please provide the partial exemption calculations (and method) for the year.

review_tests.Detection logic: De minimis test: exempt input tax ≤ £625/month average AND ≤ 50% of total input tax (or simplified tests); annual adjustment done
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the annual adjustment calculation.

review_tests.Detection logic: VAT charged on commercial rent with no option to tax evidence
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the option to tax notification and HMRC acknowledgement.

review_tests.Detection logic: Land/buildings spend ≥ £600k (items from 29 Jul 2026; £250k before); ships/aircraft ≥ £50k; computers ≥ £50k acquired before 29 Jul 2026
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm capital items in the CGS and use percentages.

review_tests.Detection logic: BDR claimed: debt < 6 months overdue, not written off, or > 4 yrs 6 months; or debt recovered later without repayment
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the bad debt relief schedule.

review_tests.Detection logic: Intercompany recharges with VAT inside a VAT group, or without VAT outside a group
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm VAT group membership and recharge arrangements.

review_tests.Detection logic: Purchase/sale of a business or property let as business with VAT charged (or not)
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the sale agreement and confirm whether TOGC conditions were met.

review_tests.Detection logic: Construction services to VAT & CIS-registered customer charged with VAT, and no end-user/intermediary notice
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm customer VAT/CIS status and any end-user notifications.

review_tests.Detection logic: Purchases from CIS subcontractors with no reverse-charge entries
review_tests.Query to client: Reverse-charge VAT does not appear on purchases from subcontractors. Please confirm.

review_tests.Detection logic: Mobile phones/computer chips ≥ £5,000 B2B with VAT charged
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm sales of specified goods and customer status.

review_tests.Detection logic: Travel/private hire: TOMS margin, input tax on margin costs claimed; private hire operator using TOMS after 2 Jan 2026
review_tests.Query to client: Please describe how travel services are bought and resold.

review_tests.Detection logic: Second-hand goods margin scheme without stock book / VAT invoices showing VAT on margin items
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the margin scheme stock book.

review_tests.Detection logic: Hospitality: hot food/eat-in vs cold takeaway; compulsory service charge; tips
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide the POS VAT analysis by product type.

review_tests.Detection logic: Retail scheme in use: method/eligibility; mixed-rate sales
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the retail scheme used and its calculations.

review_tests.Detection logic: Accrued income / deferred income journals at YE carrying VAT
review_tests.Expected: VAT follows tax point, not the accounting adjustment

review_tests.Detection logic: Capitalised items: VAT recovered in full at tax point (not spread); CGS test
Deposits/retentions: VAT at payment/invoice date
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm deposits and retentions invoiced or received.

review_tests.Detection logic: Payments to individuals outside payroll / staff supplied by agencies coded zero
review_tests.Expected: VAT on full charge for staff supplies
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm the nature of payments to [individuals/agencies].

review_tests.Detection logic: Return submitted after due date (1 month + 7 days); points total vs threshold (annual 2, quarterly 4, monthly 5)
Payment date vs due date: days 1–15 interest only; 16–30 first penalty 3%; 31+ 3% + 3% + 10% p.a. second penalty
review_tests.Query to client: Please confirm payment dates and any Time to Pay arrangement.

review_tests.Detection logic: Net errors found per period vs threshold (£10k, or 1% Box 6 up to £50k); age of error vs 4-year limit
review_tests.Query to client: Errors of £[x] were identified. We recommend correcting via [method].

review_tests.Detection logic: Invoice content (sales): VAT no., sequential number, tax point, rate, VAT amount; ≤ £250 simplified
review_tests.Query to client: Please provide a sample of sales invoices.

box_recon.Line: Box 2 VAT due on acquisitions (NI goods only)
Add: other taxable income in TB (rent opted, commission, asset sales)
Less: outside-scope / non-taxable income in turnover
Time-apportion / cut-off adjustment for non-coterminous quarters
